🔬 Pipeline Metodológico de Extracción (WsiCaption)

1. Emparejamiento de Datos: Asociación de láminas diagnósticas DX1.svs de biopsia y resección en TCGA con sus respectivos reportes PDF de patología quirúrgica.

2. Reconocimiento Óptico (OCR): Conversión de PDF a imagen con PyMuPDF (fitz) y extracción de texto mediante Tesseract OCR.

3. Limpieza y Reestructuración con LLM: Filtrado de información redundante y encabezados administrativos mediante GPT para generar un reporte narrativo conciso y de alta densidad clínica.

4. Preprocesamiento Visual (CLAM): Segmentación de tejido con umbralizado de Otsu, extracción de parches contiguos de $256\times 256$ px y extracción de vectores de 1024 dimensiones con ResNet-50.

5. Modelo Generativo MI-Gen: Módulo de atención con información de posición espacial (Multiple Instance Generation) que traduce las bolsas de parches gigapíxel en reportes diagnósticos fluidos.

Alineación con la Tesis de Maestría: PathText constituye el benchmark de referencia a nivel de lámina completa (WSI) para evaluar si los modelos multimodales preentrenados (MLLMs) son capaces de sintetizar hallazgos a escala gigapíxel y generar diagnósticos comprensivos sin requerir etiquetas a nivel de parche.

CASO CLÍNICO WSI #2 • TCGA-BRCA

Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Grade 3 with DCIS & Necrosis

Whole Slide Image Train (Benchmark) 205 Palabras
📋 Reporte Patológico Estructurado & Caption Diagnóstico (Generado vía OCR + LLM Pipeline):

Patient ID O-3 underwent a surgical procedure consisting of a biopsy of the sentinel lymph node in the right axilla, a mastectomy of the right breast, and a mastectomy of the left breast. The pathological report reveals that the sentinel lymph node biopsy was negative for any cancerous cells. However, the right breast mastectomy showed invasive ductal carcinoma grade 3, measuring 4.5 cm in the largest dimension, with ductal carcinoma in situ grade 3 and necrosis. The excision margins were negative. The left breast mastectomy showed focal atypical ductal hyperplasia with negative margins. Additionally, four lymph nodes from the right axilla were removed and were found to be negative for any signs of cancer. The microscopic description provides further details about the histologic type, grade, architectural scores, and other characteristics of the tumors. The report also mentions the presence of fibrocystic changes and apocrine metaplasia in the non-tumorous breast tissue. Prognostic markers from a previous core biopsy are referenced for further evaluation. The gross description provides information about the size and location of the tumors and lymph nodes. Overall, the report confirms the presence of invasive ductal carcinoma in the right breast and provides additional details about the characteristics of the tumor and lymph nodes.

CASO CLÍNICO WSI #3 • TCGA-LGG

Astrocytoma Grade I / Gemistocytes & Spindle Cells

Whole Slide Image Full Cohort (LGG) 109 Palabras
📋 Reporte Patológico Estructurado & Caption Diagnóstico (Generado vía OCR + LLM Pipeline):

The pathology report indicates that there is a tumor located in the left frontal lobe of the brain. The tumor is 10x8x4 cm in size and has a soft, brown-white surface with moderate margins. Microscopically, the tumor shows loose architecture and infiltrates the surrounding benign brain tissue. It is composed of groups of gemiscytes and spindle cells, with elongated and irregular nuclei that are hyperchromatic and have small nucleoli. Mitotic figures are present, indicating active cell division. The tumor also has a fibrillar background and hyperplastic blood vessels. It is necrotic and shows hemorrhage and invasion of lymphocytes. The diagnosis is Astrocytoma, grade I. No additional comments are provided.

Moderately to Poorly Differentiated Lung Adenocarcinoma

Whole Slide Image Full Cohort (LUAD) 106 Palabras
📋 Reporte Patológico Estructurado & Caption Diagnóstico (Generado vía OCR + LLM Pipeline):

The pathology report describes a surgical resection of a lung mass and lymph nodes in a patient with a preoperative diagnosis of lung mass. The frozen section diagnosis indicates poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma in the left upper lobe of the lung. The gross description and subsequent histology confirm the presence of a 2.2 cm tumor confined to the lung, with clear margins of resection, and negative lymph nodes for metastatic carcinoma. No direct extension of the tumor or invasion of large vessels was observed, and distant metastasis cannot be assessed. The final diagnosis is moderate to poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma confined to the lung and negative lymph nodes.

Renal Cell Carcinoma (Clear Cell, Fuhrman Grade III, pT1bN0M0)

Whole Slide Image Full Cohort (KIRC) 188 Palabras
📋 Reporte Patológico Estructurado & Caption Diagnóstico (Generado vía OCR + LLM Pipeline):

The pathology report indicates that the patient has several conditions affecting their right kidney.

1. Chronic allograft nephropathy: This condition is severe and is affecting the transplanted kidney. There is also evidence of calcific graft atherosclerosis.
2. Mild to moderate lymphoid hyperplasia: This is a condition where there is an overgrowth of lymphoid tissue.

Additionally, the report mentions findings from a separate study of the patient's native kidney:

1. Renal cell carcinoma: The patient has a tumor in their native kidney that is classified as a granular and clear cell type. It is classified as Fuhrman's nuclear grade III. The tumor has focal involvement of the pelvi-calyceal system. Surgical resection of the tumor showed clear margins, and there was no evidence of vascular invasion. The clinical stage is T1b, No regional lymph node metastasis, No distant metastasis, and it is classified as G3.
2. Separate low grade renal cystic neoplasm: There is a small tumor in the native kidney that has focal papillary architecture.
3. End-stage renal disease with multiple cysts: The patient has advanced kidney disease in both the transplanted and native kidneys, with multiple cysts present.
